usage: The word '想' (soeng2) commonly means 'to want' or 'to think about' and is used to express desire or intention.
'想' can be used before verbs to indicate wanting to do something, like '我想食嘢' (I want to eat).
It can also be used to express thoughts or considerations, for example, '我想今晚去睇戲' (I am thinking of going to watch a movie tonight).
When combined with questions, '想唔想' means 'do you want to…?', such as '你想唔想飲茶?' (Do you want to drink tea?).
'想' can also soften requests when used politely, e.g., '我想問你一啲嘢' (I want to ask you something).
